about_the_game: This is an affordable and fun casual tennis game featuring anime-style beautiful girls. The gameplay is very simple - just slide the screen with the mouse. There are over ten beautiful girls to choose from, allowing players to freely select both their own and their opponent's characters. Each character has a special victory animation that plays after winning a game.
